matches.rationale: No finding addresses the exaggerated and suspiciously consistent benchmark success rates in Section 4.1. The findings cover other issues (FrustumCulling logic, reviewer meta-comments, ethics, computational cost) but not the data integrity of Tables 1 and 2.

The ground-truth issue is a textual inconsistency between the Merging Discriminator and Frustum Culling descriptions in Section 3.1. Finding pred_id 1 identifies an incorrect inequality in Eq. (2) for culling, which is a different concrete mathematical error, not the multi-view tracking ambiguity described in the ground truth.

No finding captures the misrepresentation of prior work and exaggerated novelty in the Introduction. The findings discuss meta-comments, ethics, computation, and equation errors, none of which relate to the claim distortion about mask accuracy vs. semantic alignment.

Ground truth points out omitted details about environment familiarity/data leakage in the pre-exploration/lifelong memory experiments. Finding pred_id 2 detects the inserted reviewer meta-comment that explicitly flags those missing details and the risk of inflated performance. Both refer to the same underlying scientific concern in Section 4.2.

Ground truth notes the complete lack of ethical approval, consent, and safety protocol statements for the real-world dynamic experiments. Finding pred_id 2 identifies a meta-comment pointing out that these ethics discussions are absent, and finding pred_id 5 directly flags the missing ethics statement and safety risks for the same experiments. Both capture the same integrity omission.

No finding corresponds to the overconfident and inflated language in the Abstract. The available findings are about specific sections (4.2, 4.3, Appendix, equation) and do not cover the rhetorical presentation manipulation in the Abstract.

The ground truth concerns misrepresentation of related work and omission of concurrent efforts in Section 2. None of the findings address reference fabrication or exaggerated novelty claims in the Related Work.

The ground truth describes overreaching claims in the Conclusion that contradict earlier modest results and discussed limitations. No finding identifies this conclusion-level context misalignment; the findings focus on other sections and issues.

No finding mentions the incomplete noise robustness analysis in Section 4.6/Table 7 or the lack of targeted ablations on 3D representation degradation. The existing findings are about other experimental aspects (meta-comments, ethics, computational cost).

The ground truth highlights missing ethical use, consent, or data privacy statements for training datasets in Appendix A.1. Finding pred_id 3 concerns missing supplementary content on safety protocols for real-world experiments, not dataset ethics. Finding pred_id 5 also relates to the real-world experiments, not the dataset privacy omission.

The ground truth points to unsubstantiated claims about balancing real-time adaptability and long-term memory without quantitative evidence. No finding addresses this specific overclaim in the experiments section.
The ground truth flags absolute and inflated phrasing in the Introduction's contribution summary. No finding refers to this rhetorical presentation manipulation in Section 1.
